title: Lagged CFTC top-four net concentration level for BTC long or cash
thesis: A strictly positive normalized balance of top-four net-long versus net-short concentration in CME Bitcoin futures may identify concentrated informed or risk-bearing demand under which full-capital BTC exposure has better fee-adjusted risk economics than unconditional buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each eligible CFTC Tuesday report, subtract top-four net-short concentration from top-four net-long concentration and divide by their sum. Make the state usable seven calendar days after the report at 00:00 UTC; hold BTC while the factor is strictly positive and zero-yield cash otherwise until the next eligible weekly update.
economic_rationale: A peer-reviewed cross-market study preregisters the exact normalized concentration formula, positive direction and stronger two-to-four-week horizon, but excludes Bitcoin. The BTC transfer must first pass independent 672-hour predictive gates, then preserve sufficient upside while improving drawdown and Calmar without leverage or shorting.
